RAJYA  SABHA

List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

————
(Ministries : Culture; Development of North-Eastern Region; Heavy Industries
and Public Enterprises; Human Resource Development; Information and

 Conservation and restoration of
statue of Lord Gomateshwara
*361. SHRI LALIT SURI:
DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the world's
tallest statue of Lord Gomateshwara and
its supporting structures need to be
strengthened;
(b) if so, the steps undertaken by the
Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) for
conservation and restoration of the heritage
structure; and
(c) whether there is any proposal with
the ASI for installing a lightning conductor
to protect the statue?
Dues of Post Matric Scholarship
Scheme
*362. SHRI  DATTA MEGHE:
SHRI VASANT CHAVAN:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a huge accumulation of dues,
under 100 per cent Centrally sponsored
Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for the
Other Backward Classes is to be paid to
the Government of Maharashtra and other
States;
(b) if so, the amount thereof, due to
each of the States as on the 31st March
2002, 2003, 2004 and 2005; and
(c) the reasons for growing accumulation
and the steps taken for regular clearance of
such dues?
Financial assistance to Sanskrit
Pandits
*363. SHRI  SURENDRA LATH:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that two Sanskrit Pandits from
Sikkim were granted Financial Assistance
by Government for subsistence till
2003-04;
(b) whether for the financial years
2001-02, 2002-03 and 2003-04 a sum of
Rs. 85,000/- was sanctioned and given to

114
the HRD Department of the Government
of Sikkim and an amount of Rs. 55,000/-
only was paid to the Pandits for three years
as backlog, if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether it is a fact that for the year
2004-05 they have not been paid till date
and if so, the reasons therefor?
Listing of education in VII schedule
*364. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many States
have been demanding shifting of 'Education'
from the Concurrent List to the State List;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(c) whether Government recognise the
diverse socio-cultural ethos of this country
according to which the school curriculum
has to be shaped; and
(d) whether Government would bring a
constitutional amendment to shift
'Education' to the State List?
Human Scavengers
*365. SHRI  NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of URBAN EMPLOYMENT
AND POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there were 6,76,009 human
scavengers engaged throughout the country,
during 1992-1993;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(c) the existing number of human
scavengers, State-wise, as on date;
(d) the details of the budget released
and spent during the years 2002-03, 2003-
04 and 2004-05, State-wise, for
implementing the National Scheme of
Liberation and Rehabilitation of Scavengers
and their dependents; and
(e) the number of human scavengers and
their dependents rehabilitated under this
Scheme, State-wise, during  the above
period?
Encroachment on Tomb of Mirza
Ghalib
*366. DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
SHRI LALIT SURI:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the Tomb of Mirza Ghalib, the renowned
poet, situated within the Hazrat
Nizamuddin's complex in Delhi has been
encroached;
(b) if so, what steps have been taken by
the Archaeological Survey of India to
remove the encroachment; and
(c) whether any expert committee has
been constituted to protect world heritage
sites and monuments in Mehrauli
Archaeological Park, Lal Gumbaz, Firoz
Shah Kotla, Mubarkshan Tomb and other
such monuments in Delhi?
Domestic violence
*367. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been considerable
increase in domestic violence against
women during 2004-05;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the measures Government are taking
to check this trend; and
(d) the number of  cases registered during
the year and the number of persons
prosecuted?

115
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Deemed universities
*368. SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of deemed universities
sanctioned in the country, State-wise;
(b) whether such universities can open
and start any college in other States; and
(c) whether Government are aware that
unrecognised colleges in various faculties
are opened in various States without
affiliations to any university or sanction of
the concerned State Government?
Maintenance of social infrastructures
by HEC and MECON
*369. SHRI  S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Heavy
Engineering Corporation (HEC) and
MECON Ltd., Ranchi, have also been
running hospitals, schools and other social
infrastructure for their employees and
general public within or adjacent to their
operational campuses in Jharkhand;
(b) if so, the details thereof, including
the size/category of manpower involved in
management and running, average number
of beneficiaries of their services and the
annual financial support each of the above
needed during the last three years, year-
wise;
(c) whether any steps are being taken
to get rid of these infrastructures by
entrusting and/or leasing out them to private
entrepreneurs;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the reasons therefor?
Compulsory education for children
†*370. DR. FAGUNI RAM: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is mandatory to provide
compulsory education to the children in
the age group of 6 to 14 years; and
(b) the provisions made by Government
to provide compulsory education to the
children who are staying away from their
parents/guardians alongwith the number of
such children in the country?
Gandhism in elementary education
*371. SHRI SILVIUS CONDPAN: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
introduce syllabus with text books on
Gandhism relating to Gram Swaraj as well
as the history of National freedom from
elementary level of education; and
(b) whether Government would also like
to introduce from elementary education
level, the text books based on the rights
and duties of citizens and secularism
provided in the Indian Constitution?
Vacant Posts of teachers in Punjab
*372. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that thousands of posts of teachers,
particularly in primary schools in Punjab,
are lying vacant since long resulting in a set
back to student education;

116
(b) if so, whether Government have
asked for any report from the Government
of Punjab; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Review of National Education
Policy
*373. SHRI SHANTARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose a
review of the National Education Policy;
(b) the States which have framed their
own Education Policy; and
(c) whether his Ministry has examined/
scrutinised the Education Policy documents
of the State Governments to detect any
possible violations of the National
Education Policy therein?
ST status to Goud caste of Bihar
†*374. PROF. RAM DEO
BHANDARY: Will the Minister of
TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Goud caste of Bihar has
been declared as Scheduled Tribe vide
Government's notification No. S.R.O. 2477
dated 28th October, 1956 and all the
benefits had been provided to it;
(b) whether this tribe is not getting such
benefits at present in the State;
(c) whether Gouda in English, Gond,
Gonad, God are synonyms for the same
tribe; and
(d) if so, the action proposed to be taken
by Government to restore the benefits to
this tribe in the State?
AIR centres
*375. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the radio centres
opened in the country during the last three
years; and
(b) the number of AIR centres proposed
to be opened during 2005-06?
FAR norms along metro corridors
*376. SHRI BASHISTHA NARAIN
SINGH: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) by when the Dwarka-Barakhamba
MRTS route is likely to be completed and
started;
(b) whether the 500 metres corridors
along the route, which the new Master Plan
2021 proposes as influence zones, can avail
of the enhanced FAR and height proposals
of the Master Plan after the
operationalisation of the route;
(c) whether the proposals have been
taken into consideration while preparing
the new building bye laws for Delhi; and
(d) by when the new building bye laws
are likely to be implemented?
Improvement of new programme of
DD
*377. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) while in the process of allowing
private FM to 90 cities, two more private
DTH operators and FII to invest in print
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

117
companies, whether it would be possible
to upgrade the said programmes viz . current
affairs in local languages in the areas other
than Delhi;
(b) the reasons for which the local
directors of DD are hesitant to improve
the news telecast with due visuals
compared to DD from Delhi; and
(c) whether there has been any corrective
measures taken by way of enough clearance
and authority to improve performance and
set right things?
Encroachment of protected buildings
and heritage structures
†*378. SHRI DARA SINGH
CHAUHAN: Will the Minister of
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
some people have constructed houses or
opened shops and Food Plazas after
demolishing or encroaching upon a number
of protected buildings and heritage
buildings/structures;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise
and the steps taken to remove the
encroachments;
(c) whether Government are also aware
that after demolishing a heritage building at
Platform No. 1 at Nagpur Station a Food
Plaza has been opened with the connivance
of some officers; and
(d) if so, the steps taken to remove this
encroachment and to punish the culprits?
Three language formula
*379. SHRI VASANT CHAVAN: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that under the
three language formula CBSE and ICSE
students have to study only two languages
whereas the State Board schools students
have to study three languages;
(b) whether the Government of
Maharashtra has requested the Central
Government to revise the curricula to bring
about a uniformity requiring the State Board
students also to study only two language
on the pattern of CBSE and ICSE; and
(c) if so, the details of the proposal made
by the State Government, when it was
made and the decision taken by Government
in the matter alongwith the reasons for the
delay?
National Institute of Technology
*380. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of National Institute of
Technology (NITs) in the country, State-
wise;
(b) whether Government would set up
new NIT in Andhra Pradesh;
(c) the responsibilities of NITs; and
(d) whether Government would reset
the activities of NITs?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 16th August, 2005 Secretary-General.

Conservation of World Heritage
sites
2659. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
UNESCO has expressed concern over
conservation of the World Heritage Sites
(WHS) in the country;
(b) if so, whether UNESCO has called
for greater ASI role in maintenance of
WHS;
(c) if so, the steps taken by the ASI in
this regard;
(d) whether any team of UNESCO has
visited the country recently to inspect the
WHS;
(e) if so, the details of the report
submitted by the said team; and
(f) the steps taken by Government
thereon?
Survey for restoration of manuscripts
2660. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are conducting
any survey to conserve and restore
manuscripts;
(b) if so, whether Government had set
up any committee for this purpose;
(c) if so, the details of such survey taking
place in the States/UTs;
(d) whether it is also a fact that
Government are facing problem in tracking
down experienced practitioners of
traditional conservation methods who live
in far-flung areas;
(e) if so, the details thereof;

Government are taking preservation
feedback from the traditional Sri Lankan
experts;
(g) if so, the details thereof; and
(h) the expenditure incurred thereon?

Renovation of Mahaprasad Market of
Jagannath Temple
2661. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government of Orissa has asked the
Archaeological Survey of India to expedite
renovation of Mahaprasad Market of the
holy Jagannath Temple, popularly known
as Anand Bazar;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons for delay in execution of
the renovation work; and
(d) by when, it would be completed?
Language policy of NSD
2662. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the language policy of NSD
especially after grant of deemed University
status;
(b) the number of plays staged by NSD
repertory and students, language-wise,
during the last two years, indicating
Director's name and cost of production
including remuneration paid to each
Director;
(c) the achievements of Regional
Resource-cum-Research Centre so far;
(d) the details of the proposals to open
new Regional Centres;
(e) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(f) the details of the activities
undertaken by Sanskaar Rang Toli during
the last two years?
Maintenance of monuments
2663. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of the monuments/sites
under maintenance of the Archaelogical
Survey of India (ASI), State-wise;
(b) the monuments/sites proposed to
be taken over for maintenance, by ASI,
State-wise; and
(c) the details of the funds allocated for
the purpose during the last three years?
Protected monuments
2664. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the monuments being
protected by the Archaeological Survey of
India as on date, State-wise;
(b) the amount spent by Government
during the last three years;
(c) the efforts made by Government to
develop the above as places of tourists;
(d) whether certain monuments are in a
dilapidated condition and are on the verge
of collapse;
(e) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(f) the steps being taken by Government
for protection of such monuments?
One hundred fiftieth anniversary
of 1857
2665. DR. CHANDAN MITRA:
SHRIMATI SYEDA
ANWARA TAIMUR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that his Ministry

405
has earmarked a sum of Rs. 100 crore for
celebrating the 150th anniversary of the
events of 1857, also known as the first war
of Indian Independence;
(b) whether sponsorship of an official
history of the uprising of 1857, part of the
proposed celebrations;
(c) if so, the historian who have been
commissioned to write this volume(s);
(d) the basis on which historians have
identified for the project, or if they are yet
to be selected on what criteria they shall be
chosen for this project; and
(e) whether both the Pakistan and
Bangladesh have agreed to join in these
celebrations and if so, the details thereof?
Observation of UNESCO on World
Heritage Sites
2666. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that any delegation
of UNESCO has recently visited to examine
the three World Heritage Sites in Agra-Taj,
Agra Fort and Fatehpur Sikri; Hampi in
Karnataka and Bodhgaya in Bihar;
(b) if so, their observations on these
World Heritage Sites and Government's
reaction thereto;
(c) whether Government have requested
to add more sites/places in the list of World
Heritage Sites; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Impact of pollution and earthquake on
Heritage symbol
2667. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the European Union has
selected Delhi's towering heritage symbol-
Qutub Minar—as the Indian site to carry
out seismic resistance tests;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the European Union has
also been monitoring the impact of pollution
and earthquake on some other heritages
symbols in the country;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) whether they have sought
Government's permission for such
monitoring and if so, the details thereof?
Historic buildings in New Delhi
2668. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
historic buildings in New Delhi that even
officials of the ASI were unware of until
recently; and
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto?
Plan for development
of NER
2669. SHRI NABAM REBIA: Will the
Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have prepared
a comprehensive plan for the infrastructure
development in the North-Eastern Region,
particularly in Arunachal Pradesh; and
(b) if so, the details of the projects
undertaken for execution in the region during
the last three years alongwith the funds
allocated, released and utilised so far,
project-wise?

406

2670. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there are a number of
proposals which have either been returned
or lying pending with NEC for more than
one year;
(b) if so, the names of the projects; and
(c) the measures to have a considered
view on those proposals and to sanction
them?
Transportation problems in NER
2671. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the people of the North-Eastern Region
are facing transportation problem;
(b) if so, whether any steps have been
taken to alleviate their problems; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Vision documents for development of
NER
2672. SHRI NABAM REBIA: Will the
Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a 'Vision
Document' has been prepared by the NEC
as an initiative for integrated development
of North-Eastern Region;
(b) whether it is also a fact that some of
the projects included in the above

externally aided; and
(c) if so, the project-wise/State-wise
details of such projects?
PSUs under one umbrella
2673. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES

to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
bring all Central PSUs under one single
Ministry; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Functioning of Board for

Enterprises

MURTHY:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:

INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC

(a) the number of meetings of BRPSE
held since its establishment;
(b) the cases of how many PSUs have
been considered by it so far, the details
thereof;
(c) the number of cases out of the above

manufacturing capacity of these
undertakings; and
(d) the sanctioned posts of employees/
officers?
Share holders of BHEL
†2676. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
HEAVY INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state the
names of such institutions, person and
companies who hold three per cent or more
shares in the share capital of BHEL?
Revival of CPSUs in West Bengal
2677. SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE:
Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the Central PSUs
located in West Bengal, which have been
referred to BIFR;
(b) the status of revival of these units;
and
(c) the tentative time schedule for revival
of each units?
Modernization of power plants by
BHEL

Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES AND
PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the BHEL is
taking steps to modernize the existing
power plants and introducing new
technology for power generation projects;

into any collaboration with any foreign
power firms; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Revitalization of sick PSUs
2679. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR: Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that sick PSUs

Revival of PSEs

the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES

to state:

Council (NAC) has made any
recommendations to Government with
regard to revival/restructuring of Public
Sector Enterprises (PSEs);
(b) if so, details thereof; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government in respect of restructuring of
PSEs with details of the funds for the
mission?

MUKHERJEE:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) whether a recent Cabinet decision
on Price Preference Policy (PPP) for
products and services of CPSEs has been
restricted to the value of Rs. 100 crore:
(b) if so, the impact of the same on
BHEL; and
(c) how Government are compensating
the social cost borne by PSUs like BHEL,

MUKHERJEE:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) the reserve and surplus of CPSEs as
on the 31st March 2005;
(b) the reserve and surplus of top ten
CPSEs;
(c) the investible surplus; and
(d) the investment planned for the next
three years from the surplus and the
investments made during the last three
years out of this surplus?
National Education and Assessment
Council
†2684. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the objectives for constituting the
National Education and Assessment
Council;
(b) the names of its existing members;
and
(c) the manner of funding thereof?
Redressal committee in KVS and
NVS
2685. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
